item.title: How to flash Pixel Experience ROM on One Plus5
item.description: How to flash Pixel Experience ROM on One Plus5
item.content:encoded: How to flash Pixel Experience ROM Download The latest firmware #firmware The latest PE build #download Magisk (optional) #magisk Disable Dm Verity ForceEncrypt (optional) #decrypt Clean Flash Wipe system, data, cache, dalvik/art cache, vendor Flash the latest Firmware Flash ROM Flash Magisk (if you want root) Flash Disable Dm Verity ForceEncrypt (if your data was previously decryped) Wipe cache and Enjoy!
